answer: One workable design: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because ridge only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, quartz is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any nebula approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
